A Personal Note from Us

A message from the groom

Dear Family and Friends,

Some moments in life become even more meaningful when shared with the people we love. As I begin this beautiful new chapter of my life, I would be truly delighted to have you with us.

With a grateful heart, I warmly invite you to join us for our Haldi celebration on 3rd January 2027 and our wedding ceremony on 4th January 2027 at Memorial Baptist Church, Malumghat.

Your presence, blessings, and love would make these special moments even more memorable. We look forward to celebrating this beautiful occasion together with you.

With love and gratitude,

Utsaw The Groom

A message from the bride

Dear Family and Friends,

A new chapter of my life is about to begin, and I cannot imagine celebrating this beautiful journey without the people who mean so much to me.

It would bring me immense happiness to have you join us for our Haldi celebration on 3rd January 2027 and our wedding ceremony on 4th January 2027 at Memorial Baptist Church, Malumghat.

Your presence, blessings, and warm wishes would make our celebration truly special. I sincerely hope you will be there to share these precious moments with us.

With love,

Keya The Bride

Day 01

Haldi Night

Sunday · 3 January 2027

The Heart of Day One
Day One · Sunday, 3 January 2027

Haldi Ceremony

6 : 00 pm – 9 : 00 pm
VenueGroom’s Home

Turmeric, marigolds and a great deal of laughter — family and friends gather to bless the couple with golden haldi, folk songs and the oldest of traditions. Expect colour on every sleeve, and joy on every face.

Attire: Yellows, marigold, and soft pastels — wear something you don’t mind getting a little golden.
Day One · Sunday, 3 January 2027

Haldi Night Dinner

Time to be announced
VenueGroom’s Home

As the golden evening settles, we gather around the table to share a warm, festive meal — good food, good company, and one more evening together before the wedding day.

Attire: Festive and comfortable — stay in your Haldi colours.

Day 02

Wedding Day

Monday · 4 January 2027

The Main Wedding
Day Two · Monday, 4 January 2027

Holy Matrimony

6 : 00 pm – 8 : 00 pm
VenueMemorial Baptist Church, Malumghat

The sacred ceremony. Vows spoken before God and witnesses, rings exchanged, Scripture read aloud, and hymns lifted in joy. The moment everything else was leading to — witnessed by those they love most.

Attire: Formal. Suits, gowns, elegant sarees. Ivory, champagne, sage, soft gold. Shoulders covered inside the church, please.
Day Two · Monday, 4 January 2027

Wedding Dinner

8 : 00 pm – 9 : 00 pm
VenueMemorial Baptist Church, Malumghat

Immediately after the vows, the celebration moves to the table — a candlelit dinner to toast the newly married couple, share a feast, and let the joy of the day settle in.

Attire: Formal evening wear — stay in your wedding best.
Day Two · Monday, 4 January 2027

Bride & Groom Farewell

Time to be announced

The gentlest close to the day — the newly married couple bids farewell to the guests who made it all possible, with final hugs, blessings, and a send-off to begin their new life together.

A note on dressing

The Lookbook

Every event has a mood. We've put together the palettes we're dreaming of — so you can arrive in colour and feel part of the canvas.

Haldi Night · 3 Jan 2027
Maroon & Reddish Brown

Celebrate the Haldi night in rich maroons, burgundy, wine red, and warm reddish-brown tones. Choose festive traditional or contemporary outfits in these shades to create a beautiful, coordinated celebration.

Festive · Maroon & Earthy Tones
Holy Matrimony · 4 Jan 2027
Ivory & Sage

As we gather for the Holy Matrimony in church, we invite our guests to dress in elegant formal attire. Think refined suits, formal dresses, sarees, or other tasteful traditional outfits in ivory, champagne, sage, muted gold, and other understated tones. Navy or charcoal are lovely formal alternatives. Please keep shoulders appropriately covered and choose respectful, church-appropriate attire.

Formal · Church Attire
